patient_verification_rules.identity_guard: FAIL-CLOSED name (token-bag) + DOB-when-both-present match against the RESOLVED chart's own name/DOB, enforced INSIDE the vendored client BEFORE the write (SviggScraper._identity_matches), covering BOTH the app Approve path AND the MCP path. A mismatch returns status=identity_mismatch and writes NOTHING (mapped here to status=failed with a proof screenshot of what the guard saw). Additive to the strong-match gate above; the bridge adapter passes patient name+dob in so the guard can bind.

actions.success_condition: submitted_verified — the client's OWN date-guarded live grid re-read immediately after Submit finds the patient on the target date; the POST response alone is never trusted.
failure_modes: identity_mismatch (fail-closed name/DOB guard refused the write)
callback_conflict (residual AutoReserve callback-table entry blocks re-book)
submit_unconfirmed (Submit posted but the grid re-read did NOT find the patient — never trusted as success)
execute_blocked (SVIGG_BOOKING_EXECUTE off or acct not in BOOKING_ALLOWED_ACCTS)
actions.retry_behavior: on slot_full re-post with Submit=Overbook + Duration00; TFORMCOUNT is parsed FRESH from each rendered form (never computed/reused); never trust 'submitted' without the client's own verified re-read.
actions.approval_requirements: human approval required; single-use approval token checked at the POST site; acct allowlist enforced; identity guard is an additional fail-closed net.

post_action_verification.method: the client itself re-reads the live grid (date-guarded) immediately after Submit and returns submitted_verified ONLY on a positive re-read, else submit_unconfirmed — the POST/302 alone is never trusted.
post_action_verification.screenshot_proof: the client captures a proof screenshot on EVERY terminal outcome — success AND rejection/refusal (identity_mismatch, no_free_slots, slot_conflict, date_not_on_grid, overbook_click_failed, submit_unconfirmed). The envelope carries proof_captured + proof_kind ('completed' on a verified success, 'rejected' otherwise) + screenshot_id.
post_action_verification.only_success_if: the re-read positively confirms the change; otherwise return status=failed or needs_human_review — NEVER trust the POST response alone.

preconditions: TRIPLE GATE for any real Save: SVIGG_CREATE_EXECUTE=1 (module kill-switch) AND dry_run=False AND confirm_unverified=True. Fail-closed: missing any one => execute_blocked, nothing written. NOTE: the app approval executor DELIBERATELY forces dry_run=True (approval authorizes discovery, not an unverified live save).
execution_steps: Open patientEntry_new.htm; fill LastName/FirstName/MI/BirthDate/SSN/Account; POST the name-search DE-DUPE (read-only).
If an existing pentry.htm?rowid match surfaces for the same name+dob -> STOP, report duplicate_suspected (never double-create).
Open patientEntry_add.htm; DISCOVER add-form fields from the rendered DOM; map demographics (missing optionals render as honest blanks, never invented).
dry_run (DEFAULT): return discovered_fields + would_submit payload; commit NOTHING.

commit (triple-gated): fill demographics into the LIVE add form and click the HAR-confirmed NextTab submit (POST pentry.htm, Referer patientEntry_add.htm, ~53 params) — hidden tokens serialize from the rendered DOM (no stale hardcoding).

MANDATORY post-save re-search: independently re-search Svigg for the patient. created_verified ONLY on a positive re-read; else created_unverified + a loud warning (an HTTP 200 is NEVER trusted as success).

actions.retry_behavior: never double-create (de-dupe gate); commit stays fail-closed unless the triple gate is fully open AND the NextTab control is positively identified; success is claimed ONLY from a positive post-save re-search.

post_action_verification.only_success_if: the re-search positively confirms the new chart; otherwise return created_unverified (needs_human_review) — NEVER trust the HTTP 200 alone.
